Deepa Banerjee | deepa.banerjee819@example.com | +91 9206444049
Remote
Notice period: 30 days

Professional Summary
Talent acquisition professional with hands-on experience across recruitment lifecycle, employer branding, and applicant tracking. Proven track record of sourcing, screening, and closing candidates across technology and retail sectors using Workday and LinkedIn Recruiter. Strong collaboration with hiring managers and HR partners to meet hiring targets and improve time-to-fill.

Technical Skills
Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, LinkedIn Recruiter, Workday, Linux, Confluence

Work Experience

Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Saffron Bank (Jan 2026 - Present)
- Led end-to-end Recruitment for mid-to-senior engineering and finance roles, reducing average time-to-fill by 18% through targeted sourcing and pipeline management using Workday.
- Designed and executed structured interview plans and scorecards, improving hiring manager satisfaction while tracking candidate progress in Workday.
- Built talent pools with LinkedIn Recruiter outreach and passive candidate engagement; coordinated offers and onboarding documentation tracked in Confluence.

Recruiter, Quanta Retail (Jul 2024 - Dec 2025)
- Managed high-volume Recruitment for retail merchandising and technology teams, sourcing via LinkedIn Recruiter and internal referrals to meet monthly hiring targets.
- Administered candidate data and requisitions in Workday, ensuring timely updates and compliance with hiring workflows.
- Partnered with hiring managers on role briefs and selection criteria to improve offer acceptance rates and shorten time-to-hire.

HR Executive, Ola (May 2023 - Jun 2024)
- Supported Talent Acquisition operations for regional driver-partner and corporate hiring, executing sourcing strategies via LinkedIn Recruiter and job boards.
- Maintained candidate records and vacancy tracking in Workday, coordinating interviews and candidate communications.
- Documented processes and onboarding checklists in Confluence to streamline new hire experience.

HR Executive, Tata Consultancy Services (Oct 2018 - Apr 2023)
- Conducted campus and lateral Recruitment drives for IT and consulting roles, sourcing and screening candidates and managing interview logistics.
- Operated Workday for requisition creation, candidate status updates, and offer processing to improve recruiting cycle efficiency.
- Collaborated with hiring leads on role requirements and candidate fit, contributing to improved selection quality.

Education
BBA, Christ University
